supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; holdout with X1,X2,X3 gives test R2 0.76.
Full regression coef 0.18, p=1.5e-5; adding X4,X5 raises holdout test R2 only modestly (0.765 to 0.772).
Full regression coef 0.147, p=0.0004; small incremental holdout gain.
Interaction coef 0.749, p=1.5e-18, delta R2 0.074 in the two-variable model; this was not checked in the full model or holdout, so it is tentative.

interaction_claims.reason: p=1.5e-18 and delta R2 0.074 in the Y~X4+X5+X4:X5 model, which is a strong signal, though main effects of X4 and X5 are small and this was not confirmed on holdout.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression only; no experimental or identification evidence for causality.
